## Summary

Describe what changed, why, and which issue owns the work.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation

## Checks

- [ ] Recorded the applicable [local validation](https://github.com/gagexhill/grid-wallpaper/blob/main/OPERATIONS.md#validate) results.
- [ ] Identified any installed Windows checks still pending.
- [ ] Updated affected user instructions and removed private data from shared evidence.
